name: Broadway
summary: Broadway Shopping Center is a 74,988 square foot neighborhood retail center anchored by El Ahorro Supermarket, Melrose, and Blink Fitness. Strategically located on a major Houston thoroughfare near Hobby Airport, the center serves a dense population of over 117,000 residents within 3 miles with essential retail and services.
demographics: Broadway Shopping Center serves a diverse, working-class community with a dense population of over 117,000 residents within a 3-mile radius. The trade area features average household incomes of approximately $72,000, with a strong Hispanic market presence as evidenced by anchor tenant El Ahorro Supermarket. The center attracts value-conscious shoppers and families seeking everyday necessities, with a daytime population exceeding 135,000 workers within 3 miles who contribute to weekday traffic patterns. The location's proximity to William P. Hobby Airport and major thoroughfares brings additional transient customers and commuters to the center.
description: Broadway Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination strategically positioned at 8201 Broadway Boulevard in Houston's southeast corridor. Anchored by El Ahorro Supermarket, Melrose, and Blink Fitness, this 74,988 square foot center serves as a vital community hub for the surrounding dense residential area. The property benefits from exceptional visibility and access, with over 25,000 vehicles passing daily on Broadway Street and 23,000 on Bellfort Street, plus convenient proximity to I-45 which carries more than 250,000 vehicles daily. The center's tenant mix reflects the needs of its diverse community, featuring essential services including Family Dollar, Cricket Wireless, Boost Mobile, Charming Nails, medical offices, and dining options like Pizza Hut. Located on a major thoroughfare connecting Houston to William P. Hobby Airport, which serves over 4.7 million passengers annually, Broadway Shopping Center continues to serve the everyday shopping and service needs of its thriving neighborhood.
